{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Ace}}
{{Quote|Pretty motley assortment&hellip; even when you add one Corellian space ace like me&hellip;|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 11">[[Star Wars (1977) 11|''Star Wars'' (1977) 11]]</ref>}}
[[File:StarfighterAce-SoT.png|thumb|right|250px|An [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] ace pilot with 6 [[kill marker]]s]]
The title of '''ace''' or '''space ace''' was conferred onto any [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] or [[Airspeeder/Legends|combat airspeeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who had achieved five or more kills against enemy forces in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]]. The origins of the title were unknown, but the status held equal import regardless of the era in which it was earned. Many pilots throughout the [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] earned the title of ace, with many of them exceeding the minimum number of victories by considerable margins. Among the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], particularly exceptional aces could be given the title of "[[Tan (title)|Tan]]," which would be used before their full name.

==Description==
Aces were veteran [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who had proven their skill by surviving countless [[Starfighter combat|combat engagements]]. They were highly experienced pilots who felt truly alive while in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], testing their own skills against their peers while determined to see who was the better flier. For some aces, the thrill of combat was enough for them. It did not matter if they killed their enemy, only that they survived and the mission objectives were achieved. Others relished the adrenaline surge that came from destroying an opponent. The best aces often learned how to stop enemy pilots by disabling their craft without destroying them and particularly skillful pilots had their maneuvers and kills studied in training academies.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Aces were often part of a starfighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] rather than operating independently. These pilots were usually placed in command of the unit, and on the rare occasions that they were not, it was because the entire squadron was comprised of aces such as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="RPG-Core" />

==Behind the scenes==
Starfighter Ace was one the five prestige classes detailed in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RPG-Core" /> 

In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', players have to complete all the missions from a particular squadron before they are awarded the title "ace."
